issue_context.title: kmsv2: add metric for current size of DEK seed cache
issue_context.body:
Follow-up to https://github.com/kubernetes/kubernetes/issues/111920.

- [ ] Add metrics for cache fill percentage of the seed cache
- [ ] Add [TestEnvelopeCacheLimit](https://github.com/kubernetes/kubernetes/blob/674eb36f92dcea33e47ac07d71d88ebe9f5c4c6d/staging/src/k8s.io/apiserver/pkg/storage/value/encrypt/envelope/kmsv2/envelope_test.go#L180-L216) unit test back if it's relevant with new cache implementation.

/sig auth
/kind feature
comments: This is `v1.28` blocker if https://github.com/kubernetes/kubernetes/issues/117725 is going to be done!
If we decide to go ahead this implementation, we need to consider adding a metric for eviction (xref: https://github.com/kubernetes/kubernetes/pull/90650)

> This is `v1.28` blocker if #117725 is going to be done!

That issue was moved to #118831
/retitle kmsv2: add metric for current size of DEK seed cache

We decided that we can keep using the existing LRU cache with a TTL/unbounded size for the DEK seeds.  This issue now tracks adding a metric that emits the current size of that seed cache which will give the cluster operator a sense of how many KMS calls will be required on a restart of the API server.

review_comments: Add some inline comments to describe what this test is doing with all the states / transform data.
